643-1309-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
643-1309-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Maskwood Nexus, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Salvager of Secrets token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1479-2841-3897-7201.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Terramorphic Expanse.
1479-2841-3897-7201.description:
Fetch a land using Terramorphic Expanse.
When the fetched land enters, Sapling Nursery and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Sapling Nursery trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Sapling Nursery from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Sapling Nursery triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

2281-4247-5925.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Jackdaw Savior.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Jackdaw Savior.
When Jackdaw Savior dies, it and Saffi trigger.
Resolve the Jackdaw Savior trigger, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Saffi trigger, returning Jackdaw Savior from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

1981-2415-5256-6720.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-5256-6720.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Case of the Uneaten Feast triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

4682-6753-7890.notablePrerequisites: At least two opponents cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.
4682-6753-7890.description:
Activate Gleaming Splendor by paying {2}{W}, causing two opponents to each draw a card.
Smothering Tithe triggers twice, creating four Treasure tokens due to Exalted Sunborn
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{W}.
Repeat any number of times.
Once you have near-infinite Treasure tokens, you may repeat the loop targeting yourself as one of the players in step 1, drawing any number of cards.

4067-4435-6827-7824.easyPrerequisites: You have at least two cards in hand.
4067-4435-6827-7824.description:
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, tapping Spider-Gwen.
Spider-Gwen triggers, causing you to discard a card and draw four cards.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Spider-Gwen.
Repeat.

1580-2292-2301-4871.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Abzan Ascendancy trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.n: Dion, Bahamut's Dominant // Bahamut, Warden of Light

2034-5003-7657.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dion, adding {C}{C}.
When Dion dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Dion from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Dion enters, it triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

2034-4094-5086-5183-6996.easyPrerequisites:
Kaya has two or more loyalty counters on it.
Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
2034-4094-5086-5183-6996.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

774-3478-6763.description:
Pay {1} to activate Patron of the Moon, putting Dimir Aqueduct from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters, it triggers.
Activate Dimir Aqueduct by tapping it, adding two mana.
Resolve Dimir Aqueduct's triggered ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

628-2921-7216.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Moonlit Lamenter.
When Moonlit Lamenter dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability
Repeat.

4708-5660-6701.description:
Activate Dark Sphere by tapping and sacrificing it.
Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters equal to its power on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Dark Sphere from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Dark Sphere ability.
Cast Dark Sphere by paying {0}.
Repeat.

628-2511-3723.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Carnifex Demon.
When Carnifex Demon dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability
Repeat.

283-7014-7163.easyPrerequisites: You are able to put a triggered ability on the stack.
283-7014-7163.description:
Put any triggered ability on the stack.
Holding priority, activate Mister Fantastic by paying {R}{G}{W}{U} and tapping it, targeting that ability.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers. Holding priority, activate North Pole Patrol by tapping it, untapping Mister Fantastic.
Activate Mister Fantastic by paying {R}{G}{W}{U} and tapping it, copying Illusionist's Bracers' trigger twice
Resolve the first copy of Illusionist Bracers' trigger, copying Mister Fantastic's ability, targeting Illusionist's Bracers' trigger.
Resolve the copy of Mister Fantastic's ability, copying Illusionist's bracers' trigger twice.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-3941-4331-4993.description:
Activate Coveted Jewel by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Manifold Key's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Coveted Jewel.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Manifold Key from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Manifold Key by paying {1}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Manifold Key enters.
Repeat.

3585-5147-7084.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Greensleeves triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

250-779-1479-1659-1669.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-1659-1669.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Seed the Land and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Thaumatog by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Thaumatog ability
Resolve the Seed the Land trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Seed the Land triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

480-6797-6981-7077.description:
Cast Illicit Masquerade by paying {3}{B}. When it enters, its first ability triggers, putting an impostor counter on Skullbriar.
Cast Perigee Beckoner for its warp cost by paying {1}{B}.
When Perigee Beckoner enters, it triggers, targeting Skullbriar.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Perigee Beckoner.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Skullbriar.
When Skullbriar dies, Illicit Masquerade's second ability and Skullbriar's ability granted to it by Perigee Beckoner trigger.
Resolve the Skullbriar trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Illicit Masquerade trigger, failing to exile Skullbriar as it has left your graveyard and returning Perigee Beckoner from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability from step 5.
Repeat from step 3.

3490-3755-6791-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
3490-3755-6791-7075.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

1429-1477-6792.description:
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters, Mm'menon triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Resolve the Extruder ability.
Repeat.

338-671-3197.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-671-3197.description:
Gain life.
Light of Promise triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

851-2043-4659-6671.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating two token copies of Magic Pot that are 1/1 Soldiers.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing the Magic Pot tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the Magic Pot tokens die, they trigger, creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Repeat.

4067-6609-6610.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a nonland permanent you control
4067-6609-6610.description:
Activate O'aka by tapping it and removing a counter from a nonland permanent, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping O'aka.
Ivora triggers, putting a counter on it.
Repeat.

2034-4484-6440.notablePrerequisites: A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich died this turn.
2034-4484-6440.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ebondeath.
Repeat.

254-411-4103-4613.notablePrerequisites: You have cycled Yidaro at least three times this game.
254-411-4103-4613.description:
Cast First Day of Class by paying {1}{R}.
Activate Yidaro's cycling ability by paying {1}{R} and discarding it.
Yidaro triggers, putting it from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Yidaro enters the battlefield, First Day of Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Yidaro.
Resolve the Yidaro cycling ability, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Yidaro using Grinning Ignus's ability by paying {1} and returning Yidaro from the battlefield to your hand, adding {C}{C}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.

1274-1545-3490-4659.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-1545-3490-4659.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Trostani triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Heliod triggers, holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Heliod trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

1698-2146-3260-3540.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least four creatures.
You have at least three opponents.
1698-2146-3260-3540.description:
Cast Mourning by paying 2 life if able, or {B} otherwise.
Each creature you control's extort ability triggers.
Resolve the first extort trigger, causing you to pay 2 life if able, or {W/B} otherwise, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain that much life.
Repeat step 3 for each remaining extort trigger.
Resolve Mourning, attaching it to a creature you control.
Activate Mourning by paying 2 life, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat until an opponent loses the game due to having 0 or less life.
1698-2146-3260-3540.notes: Once you have two or less opponents, the combo no longer makes enough life to continue. You may repeat the loop using your own resources as desired.

1329-1750-2099-2793-5261.description:
Activate Sarcatog's second ability by sacrificing Ugin's Nexus, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
When Ugin's Nexus is sacrificed, it is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Pull from Eternity without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Pull from Eternity, putting Ugin's Nexus from exile into your graveyard.
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Ugin's Nexus.
Cast Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard by paying {5}.
Repeat.

3946-5449-5967.description:
Play Glacial Chasm either from your hand or from your graveyard.
When Glacial Chasm enters the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice another land you control.
Play any land from your graveyard.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Glacial Chasm's cumulative upkeep ability triggers, allowing you to choose not to pay the cost and sacrifice it instead.
Repeat.

1525-2031-2406-2660-2665.notablePrerequisites:
Progenitor Mimic is a copy of Stormchaser Drake.
Wheel of Sun and Moon attached to you.
1525-2031-2406-2660-2665.description:
Cast Lightning Storm by paying {1}{R}{R}, targeting either copy of Stormchaser Drake.
Stormchaser Drake triggers, which due to Abundance causes you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card and put it into your hand.
Activate Lightning Storm by discarding a land card, putting that land card on the bottom of your library due to Wheel of Sun and Moon.
Resolve the Lightning Storm ability, putting two charge counters on it and changing the target to the other copy of Stormchaser Drake.
Repeat from step 2.
Once Lightning Storm has an arbitrarily large number of charge counters, activate it by discarding a land to change its target to any other target of your choosing to deal infinite damage to that target.
1525-2031-2406-2660-2665.notes: Other players may also activate Lightning Storm to change its target, making this combo risky if you do not have additional land cards in hand to activate Lightning Storm again.

730-1479-4826-5700-5701.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
730-1479-4826-5700-5701.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Emeria Angel trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Emeria Angel trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Emeria Angel triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Emeria Angel trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Emeria Angel triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

296-777-3532-5078.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
296-777-3532-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
The Thirteenth Doctor triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

4165-4222-4249.notablePrerequisites:
Wind Zendikon and Freed from the Real attached to Nykthos.
Nykthos does not have summoning sickness.
Your devotion to blue is at least four.
4165-4222-4249.description:
Activate Nykthos' second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Nykthos.
Repeat.

1494-3021-4013.manaNeeded: {2}{C} during the first turn, and every three turns afterwards
1494-3021-4013.notablePrerequisites: Sage of Hours does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
1494-3021-4013.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Conclave Sledge-Captain.
When Conclave Sledge-Captain enters the battlefield, its backup ability triggers three times, all targeting Sage of Hours.
Resolve all Conclave Sledge-Captain triggers, putting three +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours, and causing it to gain the printed abilities three times until end of turn.
Deal combat damage with Sage of Hours, triggering its abilities granted by Conclave Sledge-Captain three times, putting three +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours for each damage it dealt.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least three extra turns after this one.
Repeat during your last extra turn.

112-676-5115.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least three creature tokens.
Gemstone Array has at least one charge counter on it.
112-676-5115.description:
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {U}, putting a charge counter on Gemstone Array and returning Clockspinning to your hand.
Activate Gemstone Array's second ability by removing a charge counter from it, adding {U}.
Repeat.

864-2438-3235-3821.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{B}{B}.
864-2438-3235-3821.description:
During an opponent's combat step, activate up to five lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{B}{B}.
Cast Wake the Dead by paying {2}{B}{B}, returning Eternal Witness and Peregrine Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Peregrine Drake and Eternal Witness enter the battlefield, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands you control.
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Wake the Dead from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Carrion Feeder twice by sacrificing Peregrine Drake and Eternal Witness, putting two +1/+1 counters on Carrion Feeder.
Repeat.

868-1170-2556-4036.description:
Cast Desperate Ritual by paying {1}{R}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Mnemonic Wall.
Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, returning Seething Song from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Desperate Ritual, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Cast Seething Song by paying {2}{R}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Mnemonic Wall.
Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, returning Desperate Ritual from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Seething Song, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

2034-2577-2948.notablePrerequisites: An extra zombie on the battlefield.
2034-2577-2948.description:
Sacrifice Gravecrawler to Ashnod's Altar.
pay {2} to Initiates of the Ebon Hand to make {B}{B}.
Use {B} to cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard.
Repeat.

3031-3903.description:
Whenever a player casts a spell from their hand, Knowledge Pool triggers, exiling the spell and allowing the player to cast another card exiled by Knowledge Pool without paying its mana cost.
Drannith Magistrate prevents opponent from casting anywhere other than their hands.

950-3664-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Fatestitcher does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Fatestitcher.
950-3664-4222.description:
Activate Lotus Field by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Fatestitcher by tapping it, untapping Lotus Field.
Activate Freed from the Real's last ability by paying {U}, untapping Fatestitcher.
Repeat any number of times.
Repeat steps with a different color for infinite mana of any color.
